overview.en: The Scaly-breasted Munia is a small Asian estrildid finch; populations introduced outside its native range are established in some places.
overview.fr: Le Capucin damier est un petit estrildidé d’Asie ; des populations introduites se sont établies dans certaines régions hors de son aire native.

identification.en: Its pale underparts have dark, scale-like markings; the stout bill is adapted to seeds.
identification.fr: Son dessous clair porte des marques sombres en écailles ; son bec robuste est adapté aux graines.

habitat.en: It uses grassland, scrub, crops and other semi-open places, often near people.
habitat.fr: Il fréquente prairies, broussailles, cultures et autres milieux semi-ouverts, souvent près des habitations.

diet.en: Seeds make up most of its usual food; Australian observations also report occasional scavenging around farms and refuse.
diet.fr: Les graines constituent l’essentiel de son alimentation ; des observations australiennes signalent aussi du charognage occasionnel près des fermes et des déchets.

behavior.en: It forages in groups and can gather in flocks numbering hundreds outside the breeding season.
behavior.fr: Il recherche sa nourriture en groupe et peut former des bandes de plusieurs centaines d’individus hors de la période de reproduction.

reproduction.en: In its native Southeast Asian range, it can breed throughout the year when conditions are suitable; both sexes incubate.
reproduction.fr: Dans son aire native d’Asie du Sud-Est, il peut se reproduire toute l’année lorsque les conditions sont favorables ; les deux sexes couvent.

ecology.en: It forages from the ground and also hangs from stems to reach seeds.
ecology.fr: Il cherche sa nourriture au sol et se suspend aussi aux tiges pour atteindre les graines.

conservation.en: The global assessment cited by Cornell lists it as Least Concern and reports a stable trend; this does not describe every local introduced population.
conservation.fr: L’évaluation mondiale citée par Cornell le classe en préoccupation mineure et indique une tendance stable ; cela ne décrit pas chacune des populations locales introduites.

facts: Cornell reports flocking outside breeding season, year-round breeding when conditions permit in the native range, shared incubation, and quotes the 2016 BirdLife/IUCN assessment as Least Concern with a stable trend.

uncertainties: Descriptions of the Australian introduced population do not necessarily apply to native Asian populations. The behavioral comparison in ecology is at group level; no particular close species comparison was available in the current Bestiary.
review_note: Cross-checked an English-language life-history and conservation account with BirdLife Australia and a French-language ornithological synthesis; kept introduced-population observations geographically qualified.
